items.title: Delta Air Lines (DAL) Flags Cost Strain While Ed Bastian Details Seat Reforms
items.summary: Delta Air Lines (NYSE:DAL) CEO Ed Bastian highlighted rising costs against strong travel demand in fresh remarks this week. Bastian pointed to higher jet fuel, airport fees, and labor expenses as key pressures on profitability despite fuller planes. He also outlined moves to refine seat allocation policies, including how window seats are assigned to passengers. Bastian's comments on cost pressures and seat assignment reforms deserve weighing against the rest of our Delta analysis. Our...

items.title: Greg Abel Nearly Doubled Berkshire’s Lennar Stake and Added a $689 Million IPO Position
items.summary: Berkshire's first big moves under Greg Abel include a surprise bet on a slumping homebuilder, a fresh IPO and trims to two bank holdings. The filing shows what changed, but the real question is what Abel saw that the market missed.

items.title: DoorDash pushes back on FTC pricing inquiry: 'We don’t do surveillance pricing'
items.summary: Last month, the Federal Trade Commission launched an investigation into nine companies — including DoorDash, Uber, and Instacart — over how consumer data is used to set prices.

items.title: Airfares Are Up, Flights Are Tight: 3 Airline Stocks Facing a Winter Test
items.summary: United, Delta, and JetBlue are cutting winter seat capacity to boost yields amid high fuel costs, pushing holiday fares near decade highs while supporting margins and cash flow.
